title: Design: Delete Credit Term confirmation looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A (made for this test), due 9 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p1-11-delete-credit-term-confirmation.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the term A row.
  2. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window opens over the dimmed page (as in ct-p1-11-delete-credit-term-confirmation.png): the bold title "Confirmation" with a close × at the right, the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?", and at the bottom right "Cancel" then a red "Delete Credit Term".
  • The Cancel style (grey filled in this build picture) and the blue ×: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R9: “"Delete Credit Term" opens a confirmation titled "Confirmation" with the message "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Delete Credit Term". On confirm the term is removed from the page and a success toast shows "{name} deleted".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Delete Credit Term chosen | "Are you sure you want to delete this credit term?" | Confirmation titled "Confirmation", buttons "Cancel" and red "Delete Credit Term"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
